sponsor.title: Introduce your brand
sponsor.body: Add your logo and a short description in Settings. Tell creators what your business does and the audience you want to reach.

sponsor.title: Find the right partner
sponsor.body: Use Finder to compare content, platforms and audience fit. Save a shortlist and read each creator’s profile before making an offer.

sponsor.title: Agree the work before paying
sponsor.body: Your brief should specify deliverables, platforms, deadline, revisions and usage rights. Check the total and payment terms before confirming checkout.

sponsor.title: Approve, publish and measure
sponsor.body: Review private drafts in the offer conversation. Request changes or approve the latest version. Confirm the agreed published links, then revisit available results in your campaign history. Completion and payout are separate steps.

creator.title: Make your profile useful
creator.body: Add a photo, a clear introduction and your content categories in Settings. Explain your audience and the kinds of partnerships you welcome.

creator.title: Connect your platforms
creator.body: Connect supported social accounts from Settings. Check the permissions requested. Connections and available metrics vary by platform; you can continue without linking every account.

creator.title: Choose a suitable opportunity
creator.body: Use Finder to discover brands and opportunities. Review the brief, deadline, revisions, rights and payment terms before accepting. A proposed partnership is not a guaranteed booking.

creator.title: Deliver with a clear approval trail
creator.body: Send your private video draft in the offer conversation before publication. After approval, publish on the agreed platforms and submit the links. Check payout setup separately; marking work complete does not mean money has reached your bank.
